item.title: Help with loop function
item.description:
I am working on a project to download GBIF occurrence records for a list of species, based on a CSV file I have. The species list CSV contains over 11,000 species names for an area of interest. I want to automate the process of downloading occurrence records from GBIF for these species. I have code for this but only know how to do it for one species from a list, can I get away to write a loop function.
compiling a subset of data (15-20% of the CSV species list) for a few hundred species and combining the results into a single CSV file. I have worked out a code for the rest just need help with a loop function
\#obtain data from GBIF via rgbif
\# !! here we can improve the codes to read different species from a species list. or write a loop function to pick up every species name and run the codes
dat <- occ\_search(scientificName = "Marquesia macroura ", limit = 12000, hasCoordinate = T)
dat <- dat$data
